description: Implementation of the ProviderService interface in the OpenMRS project, containing methods for managing Provider entities including CRUD operations, role management, and retrieval based on various criteria.

classes.name: ProviderServiceImpl
classes.description: Default implementation of the ProviderService interface, providing concrete logic for managing Provider entities within the OpenMRS API.

methods.name: setProviderDAO
methods.description: Sets the data access object used for Provider database operations.

methods.name: getAllProviders
methods.description: Retrieves all providers, optionally including retired ones.

methods.name: getAllProviders
methods.description: Overloaded method to retrieve all providers with an option to include retired providers.

methods.name: retireProvider
methods.description: Marks a Provider as retired (though implementation currently just saves the provider).

methods.name: unretireProvider
methods.description: Unretires a Provider and saves the changes.

methods.name: purgeProvider
methods.description: Deletes a Provider from storage.

methods.name: getProvider
methods.description: Fetches a Provider by its ID.

methods.name: saveProvider
methods.description: Saves a Provider object, including its attributes.

methods.name: getProviderByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Provider using its UUID.

methods.name: getProvidersByPerson
methods.description: Obtains Providers associated with a specific Person, considering retired status.

methods.name: getProvidersByPerson
methods.description: Overloaded method that defaults to including retired providers.

methods.name: getCountOfProviders
methods.description: Returns count of providers matching a query, with includeRetired false by default.

methods.name: getCountOfProviders
methods.description: Returns count of providers matching a query, considering whether to include retired providers.

methods.name: getProviders
methods.description: Retrieves a list of providers matching search criteria and attributes, with pagination and inclusion options.

methods.name: getProviders
methods.description: Overloaded method with default includeRetired as true.

methods.name: getAllProviderAttributeTypes
methods.description: Fetches all provider attribute types, including retired ones.

methods.name: getAllProviderAttributeTypes
methods.description: Fetches all provider attribute types with option to include retired.

methods.name: getProviderAttributeType
methods.description: Retrieves a specific provider attribute type by ID.

methods.name: getProviderAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves provider attribute type using UUID.

methods.name: getProviderAttributeTypeByName
methods.description: Fetches provider attribute type by name.

methods.name: getProviderAttribute
methods.description: Fetches a provider attribute by its ID.

methods.name: getProviderAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a provider attribute by UUID.

methods.name: saveProviderAttributeType
methods.description: Saves or updates a provider attribute type.

methods.name: retireProviderAttributeType
methods.description: Marks a provider attribute type as retired (implementation just saves the object).

methods.name: unretireProviderAttributeType
methods.description: Restores a retired provider attribute type.

methods.name: purgeProviderAttributeType
methods.description: Deletes a provider attribute type.

methods.name: isProviderIdentifierUnique
methods.description: Checks whether a provider's identifier is unique.

methods.name: getProviderByIdentifier
methods.description: Fetches a Provider by its identifier.

methods.name: getUnknownProvider
methods.description: Retrieves the 'unknown' Provider based on a global property UUID.

methods.name: getProviderRole
methods.description: Fetches a ProviderRole by ID.

methods.name: getProviderRoleByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a ProviderRole by UUID.

methods.name: getProvidersByRoles
methods.description: Returns Providers assigned to any of the provided roles.

methods.name: getAllProviderRoles
methods.description: Retrieves all provider roles, including or excluding retired.

methods.name: saveProviderRole
methods.description: Saves or updates a provider role.

methods.name: retireProviderRole
methods.description: Marks a provider role as retired (implemented by just saving the object).

methods.name: unretireProviderRole
methods.description: Restores a retired provider role.

methods.name: purgeProviderRole
methods.description: Deletes a provider role if it’s not assigned to any providers.
